source: RFC 0007 §7.4.4 (DR1-E-3, RC review round 1 area E; direction decided by the maintainer's coordinator, 2026-11-24)
statement: A DENY of a tenant's document is the tenant's: an administrator of the tenant may remove or relax it within what it may write, whoever wrote it, a platform principal included, and the change is decided as any write of that document is. No entry of a document is protected. A restriction the platform means a tenant not to lift is the tenant's boundary, which only a platform principal sets (BDY-2), or the platform document, which a tenant cannot write (TNT-3); a DENY the platform writes into a tenant's document is advisory.
